(a)_invalid_first_read.description: labels_104.parquet was first read in an earlier run at approximately 2026-10-08T21:11:35 UTC (recorded in PROJECT_LOG.md during that session). In that run the ground truth was built by reading labels_104.parquet directly without filtering label==1, treating all 13,796,800 candidate rows as purchases. This produced Baseline B MAP@12=1.0 — an invalid result. That run's output was discarded. Ground truth was switched to build_holdout_fold(), which reads week-104 ground truth from the full transaction history. No model, parameters, features, or candidates were changed between the invalid run and the valid run.

(b)_fold103_downsampling.description: Fold-103 training negatives for the primary model (folds 100-103) were downsampled using .sample(fraction=0.2, seed=42) applied to the already-built fold_103.parquet. This is a random sample, not the hash-based rule used to build fold_103.parquet from scratch. The secondary model (folds 100-102) used the existing fold_103.parquet for validation only and is unaffected.
(b)_fold103_downsampling.note: CIs overlap substantially; the 0.000116 primary-secondary difference is well within the uncertainty of both estimates.

(c)_git_commit.description: The protocol's git_commit_hash (13ec5dc) identifies the last committed state at the time of the holdout run. Uncommitted changes present at that time include scripts/run_holdout.py, scripts/run_experiment.py, src/evaluation/ modules, and supporting files. The held-out fold_104.parquet, feature tables (folds 100-104), and model files are covered by their SHA-256 hashes recorded in the protocol and are unaffected by uncommitted code changes.

(d)_protocol_modification.description: holdout_protocol.json was modified after the label-read timestamp (mtime ≈ 2026-10-08T21:27 UTC, which is after labels_read_timestamp_utc = 2026-10-08T21:23:46Z). The script run_holdout.py added two new fields: labels_read_timestamp_utc and labels_sha256. No pre-registered field value changed. However, the field no_changes_after_label_read: true was violated because the script modified the file. The protocol has been restored to its pre-label-read state (the two added fields are now recorded only in holdout_results.json). Future runs use a version of run_holdout.py that writes all results to holdout_results.json and does not modify holdout_protocol.json.
(d)_protocol_modification.violation: no_changes_after_label_read: true was violated by run_holdout.py writing to holdout_protocol.json
